lines: Jovial male Kuva Lich voice lines.
These voice lines are affected by the weapon's element used to kill the Larvling.
- "You tore me to pieces, Tenno. That wasn't very nice."
- "Do you have any idea what it takes to reattach severed limbs? You will."
- "You tore me limb from limb. But I've pulled myself together since then. Hah."
- "You know, as I watched you hack my limbs off, I thought to myself... "I really don't like this person.""
- "Word of advice: when you kill someone, make sure it takes!"
- "I'm alive! Alive! Oh. Oh, Tenno. You have no idea what you have brought down upon your head."
- "The next time you drop someone at death's door? Knock."
- "You might have forgotten the first time we met, but I've still got the third degree burns."
- "It isn't that you immolated me. It isn't that I died. No, it's that now, the only thing I can smell is PORK."
- "You introduced me to fire. We became friends. We. don't. like. you."
- "I don't take kindly to being frozen solid."
- "Giving me the cold shoulder? For that I think I'm gonna kick your... ICE! Hahahahaha..."
- "Here's how you're getting out of here: frozen solid, covered in syrup and given to my kubrows as a sugar lick."
- "I'm gonna freeze you, feed you feet first into a snowblower and spray what comes out all over Cetus."
- "Ah Tenno. You lit up my life. And my body. And organs. And teeth. And now I'm gonna romance you just the same."
- "Remember me? The energy between us is undeniable. Some might say... electric. Ha! You fried me is what I'm saying. Get ready to die."
- "I'm going to light you up like a Corpus showroom!"
- "Your voltage contracted every muscle in my body hard enough to break every bone. Today the role of ME, will be played by YOU. Lights up!"
- "Whatever poison you pumped me full of, Friend, it didn't do what you thought it would. Heh heh heh."
- "The poison is in the dose, Friend. Whatever it was, turns out I'm partial to it. FEELING GOOD!"
- "You make me sick, Tenno. No, I mean you literally have made me violently ill and now I'm comprised primarily of foreign bacteria."
- "Your toxin. IMAGINE if a hangover could kill you. Now imagine that hangover is a person. Surprise! It's me and I'm going to kill you."
- "I hope you haven't forgotten me, Tenno. I most certainly have not forgotten you."
- "You are dead already. I know it. The System knows it. My fifteen friends who are betting on it know it."
- "Are you ignoring me, Tenno? You bruise my feelings."
- "I've been taking time to work on... me."
- Dialogue is randomly pulled from #Birth of Kuva Lich, #After Logging In, #Spawning, and #Taunts sections.

path: Navigating controlled sectors in the Star Chart
lines: - "I claim this territory in the name of yours truly."
- "Mine. Sector's a dump, but it's my dump."
- "Your little Lich is coming up in the world, Tenno."
- "I'll take that. Thaaank you. Somebody plant a flag."

path: Completing a Mission on an affected Node
lines: - "I think I have something of yours? AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"
- "Yoink! What was yours is now mine. Bye-bye."
- "Wallet feeling a little light, Friend? Heh heh heh heh."
- "Operating in MY sector, Friend? Time to pay the idiot tax."

path: After Revealing a Requiem Mod / Upgrade Rank of the Kuva Lich
lines: - "Take all the time you want, Tenno. I'm just getting stronger."
- "Bravo. You're getting closer. I really thought you'd be on me by now."
- "We're one step closer to meeting face to face. I'm so excited!"
- "I am the hunter, you are the prey. That's how this works! Questions?"
- "Friend, Friend, Friend. We keep meeting like this."
- "So, I can do violent and messy or messy and violent. Any preferences?"
- "I think they're scared. Comrades, are they scared? I think they're scared."
- "You can't kill me if you keep hitting me in the bits I've had replaced."
- "Oh no, you don't. Get back here and take what's coming to you."
- "Nice helmet! I'll use it to serve dip."

path: One Health Bar Left / After Attacking with Correct Requiem Mod
lines: - "Ugh I can taste my spleen, that's not good."
- "I'm just going to come back as something even more horrible."
- "Please Friend? Tell me that's not all you got."
- "Now you know how it feels, Friend."
- "You folded up like a dead man's spine, didn't ya."
- "Every day in every way I just get better and better."
- "Oh, Tenno. I'm a whole new me."
- "Better, stronger... cuter. You behold the Queens' number one son."
- "I'm growing in power, Friend. Stop me if you can, while you still can."
- "I told you I was unstoppable. Now you'll see what a fully evolved Kuva Lich can do."
- "You should have stopped me when you had a chance. Now I'm top of the food chain. And you're lunch."
- "You won't get rid of me that easily. I'll be back, Tenno. Oh, I'll be back."
- "Ugh. For the love of... Fine. Lich out."

path: Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "Oh! Tenno! You left something behind! I think it was your dignity."
- "Know your limitations, Friend. But I appreciate how difficult that must be given you have so many of them."
- "HAHAHAHA! Ah! The look! The look on your dumb dead face! AHH HAHAHAHAHA!"
- "You win some, you lose some HORKK!"
- "If the Queens ever find out, I'm dead meat, but... deal."
- "Sure Friend, why not? No hard feelings?"

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "Here to help! And you thought I'd betray you."
- "Let's get started! I need to work off some of this tube weight."
- "Never fear, your right-hand Grineer is here."
- "Enemies! Prepare to be hammered in your reproductive organs!"

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "I can hear the survivors screaming in terror! Hilarious."
- "Now that we're warmed up, what's next?"

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "You have to go on without me, Friend. This Grineer... falls."
- "Ouch! Got me right in the roto-spleen."
- "This void-forsaken place... is... an abomination... AND I CAN'T STOP ITCHING!"
- "Bugs in my ARMOR! This thing's air tight! HOW? AAGH!"
- "Spreading terror certainly builds up an appetite."
- "Either I need to swab out my pits, or there's a Tenno in here."
- "I can see, I'm outmatched. Good day, Tenno!"
- "Well, I don't remember you being quite so potent. Running away!"
- "Wait... if you can kill an Eximus... then... conceivably... you could kill... me? RUN!"
- "Troops, hold them off while I go for reinforcements. Oh, for the Queens."
- "Come on, Tenno. Me, by myself? That's hardly a fair fight. Be a good sport."
- "Uhh... I appear to be in this fight, alone. Could we possibly reschedule?"
- "Ugh... brats... sticky hands and... shrieking voices! Stay away!"
- "Agh! Furious children! Coming for meee! This is just like that dream I had!"
- "Last person I saw jump from this height exploded like a bag of soup! I got to get away, now!"
- "Good kubrow. Who's a good kubrow? Back. Back! GET BACK YOU MUTT!"
- "Space. Spaaace! Limitless... void! Crushing existential dread! Get it together Lich..."
- "I hate space. If I wanted to be crushed by infinite meaninglessness I'd read your diary."
- "Come here you little worm. Time for a spanking."
- "Oh, hey! Corpus how's it going pencil necks? RAAAA!"
- "Excuse me one moment Friend. I have Corpus bugs to squash!"
- "Finally just us. Those others were just holding me back."
- "I've heard the muttering... the scheming... the plotting behind my back. I know. Oh, I know..."
- "Men, sure, I may be paranoid... but that doesn't mean EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU ISN'T BACKSTABBING SCUM!"
- "Oh, my sense of balance is the worst."
- "You are gonna light up like a little girl seeing her first Pobber."
- "You are a fine trophy, Tenno. But, this particular beast has caught my eye."
- "All right, you won't understand, but I have to have that critter to my collection. Let's put this on hold for five minutes."
- "I'm either loved or hated... just because I'm so beautiful."
